name: Tome AWS
description: Deploys a Tome-generated static site to an Amazon S3 bucket (upload, redirect and metadata handling).
project_description:
The Tome AWS module enables you to deploy a static website created with the Drupal Tome module to an Amazon S3 bucket.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Incremental deploy 
 Redirect management 
 Delete obsolete files 
 Drupal 10 now supported 
 Configure your AWS s3 bucket info via admin config form. 
 
 Once you have created a static build with tome, run `drush tome-aws:deploy` to deploy it
